response.overview: Shooting Stars follows Adrián Solano, a 22-year-old Venezuelan in search of meaning who inadvertently enters the 2017 Nordic World Ski Championships despite having never seen snow in his life. Training on roller skis in one of the hottest places on Earth, his journey to the slopes unravels into a viral sports fiasco. As the internet crowns him ‘The World’s Worst Skier,’ Adrián reveals that greatness isn’t measured in medals, but in the courage to keep going.
response.title: Shooting Stars
